:::{#rem-matrix-analysis}
#### Linear algebra and matrix analysis

*[Matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) analysis* is the study of matrices and their algebraic properties,
with operations on matrices, [functions](functions.qmd#def-function) of matrices
and the [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue) of matrices as example topics
[@wikipedia_matrix_analysis].
It is usually placed within [linear](algebra.qmd#def-linear-function) algebra and its applications
[@wikipedia_matrix_analysis],
and these notes do not treat it as a separate subject:
they use the name *linear algebra* for the whole of the matrix material in the pages that follow.
@banerjee2014linear pairs the two names in its title.
Its preface says that its last chapters cover
[convergence](algebra.qmd#def-convergent-sequence) of matrices and Hilbert [spaces](linear-algebra-inner-products.qmd#def-inner-product-space)
[@banerjee2014linear, p. xvi].

:::
